verdict.rationale: Bulk operations, such as bulk filings or bulk record retrieval, are a fair question for a state business-filing and registry system, so the axis applies. The evidence pack holds only robots.txt probes showing crawling is disallowed; nothing was fetched beyond them, so there is no documented bulk-operation capability. The robots.txt policies speak to crawler access, not to whether bulk operations exist, so they neither support nor contradict this story.
